name: sunrooof-call-intelligence-api
description: Vercel serverless functions for the CI dashboard. The React app is a separate package under ci-dashboard/; this root package exists so Vercel installs dependencies for /api.
comment: No dependencies on purpose. The routes talk to PostgREST over global fetch, which Node 20+ provides, so Vercel has nothing to install for /api and there is no lockfile to drift. @supabase/supabase-js would add a client whose only job here would be to build the same URLs.
